name: Router cost fake providers
target: One llm.usage row per completed or failed text stream attempt in an isolated router world
inputs: concurrent calls and new provider after restart
unresponsive provider with a bounded deadline
SQLite lock holder killed before a new writer connection
observations: Missing usage and failed calls keep unknown token and cost fields
Silent provider times out and leaves an explicit failure row
Persisted usage calls survive SQLite lock holder death and writer reopening
